method: Exact final-build representative face-distance measurements against 1.2±0.01 mm; source normal-offset sample assertions; six valid solids, pairwise interference, clearances, reviewed assembly and isolated shade views with matching shape hash, and STEP receipt.

handle_top_joint.seat: Rod shoulders follow original curved beam underside; 8 mm nominal peg projection is measured from Z192, not a uniform shoulder.

source_parameter_checks.shade_uniform_wall_scope: Entire marked circumference: upper rounded shoulder and vertical flutes down to their scalloped lower ends.

unchanged_object_evidence.note: Receipt shape hashes prove five non-shade objects unchanged. Shade wave exterior was reparameterized to avoid loft twists while preserving named envelope/profile dimensions; opening cylinders, magnet ring and magnet cuts retain their dimensions and placements.

visual_review.finding: Corresponding internal waves extend to upper shoulder without previous thick transition bands; lower ring and two magnet pockets remain. Isolated views were reviewed at de620bc with identical final shade shape hash; final assembly preview reviewed at 7942568.

wire_route.description: Original liner recess retained. Cable exits exposed lamp cup above base rim Z12 and below shade bottom Z32; keep wire out of magnetic mating plane.

limits: No physical printing, cable fit or load test performed.

Wall is nominal 1.2 mm normal offset with spline approximation, not a proof of exact constant thickness at every surface point. Representative exact face minima are 1.1971 mm (body/shoulder), 1.1988 mm (lower flute), with top rim axial thickness 1.2 mm; upper offset samples satisfy ±0.02 mm. Unmarked magnet mounting ring remains thicker. No physical print.
Two opposed magnet pairs permit a 180-degree orientation ambiguity; magnet polarity and holding force require assembly testing.
Original lamp voltage, power and connector are unspecified; retain original cable and matched supply.
Upper and lower straight tenon joints need adhesive retention and cured-joint load testing; the clearances do not provide a mechanical pull-out lock.

liner_not_above_shade.evidence: Exact committed-build bounding boxes: liner Z106, shade Z108; height parameter remains 102 mm.

slightly_contracted_upper_opening.evidence: Current source retains circular 82.4 mm opening; current isolated top view confirms inward rim.

grooves_continue_over_inward_rim.evidence: Reviewed isolated shade views with final identical shape hash; forty flutes continue onto shoulder, exterior loft uses consistent spline parameters.

base_liner_two_magnet_locations.evidence: Exact-build base top and liner bottom views; source parameters and unchanged placements match paired hole positions.

square_joint_edge_adjustment.evidence: Current-build parameter inspection, circular-rim/square-corner calculation, isolated base top view and assembly collision/clearance check. Remaining inner wall 1.5 mm; outer top land 1.5601 mm; paired centers X±50.4 mm.

beam_rod_square_tenons.evidence: Exact-revision isolated bottom/top/isometric views, source-defined aligned square tenons/sockets and zero solid interference across all 15 pairs. Curved shoulder contact is intentional, not shared volume.

shade_shoulder_wall.evidence: Latest full-circumference requirement supersedes prior 1.5 mm shoulder; exact final-build outer/inner shoulder minimum distance plus 30 normal-offset samples during build.

shade_inner_waves.evidence: Normal-offset inner contours extend through full-height extruded flutes, no 6 mm thick blend bands; whole circumference repeats forty times.
shade_inner_waves.transition_note: Only the unmarked magnet ring remains locally thick.

water_shade.scope: Separate alternate shade: only concave transitions changed to curved tangent surfaces; convex crests and neighboring original crest facets retained. Original six-solid lantern geometry and export unchanged.

surface.user_requirement: Smooth marked concave transitions while keeping sharp convex ridge corners and unequal naturally flowing bands.
surface.geometry: Each original valley is replaced by a tangent quadratic blend over 65% of each adjoining control leg. Original crest curves, remaining 35% crest-adjacent outer facets, independent harmonic phases and width variation retained. Outer blends are degree-2 smooth lofts, not ruled facets.

measurements.evidence: Current-build cylinders f12 and f13 at X±39.2 have radius3.6 and Z0..2.15; source additionally checks both openings and retained hole floors.

wall_validation.method: Exact distance from sampled analytical outer-surface points to constructed inner skin, asserted during the committed build; top axial wall measured separately. Inner curved loft approximates surface-normal offset with 13 sampled sections.
wall_validation.limitation: The broader range includes neighborhoods of intentionally sharp convex miters. Constant pointwise thickness at sharp corners is not claimed. Source sampling is not an exhaustive thickness analysis.

visual_review.finding: Concave troughs are visibly rounded with continuous shading into their two original neighboring facets. Convex crest corners remain crisp; the independently flowing widths and original end profiles remain. Two magnet pockets and retained bottom ring are visible.

limits: No physical print, heat or magnet retention test performed.
Interchangeability is checked by preserved dimensions and envelope, not a full substituted-assembly interference test.
Concave surfaces have a nominal1.2mm normal offset with bounded samples. Sharp convex miter neighborhoods remain locally thicker; no exhaustive pointwise wall certification.

source_derived.method: Original pre-blend control contour heights at360 azimuths; not remaining flat-facet widths, rounded valley depth or normal wall thickness.

width_variation_checks.acceptance: Each main band has a nonzero width range around the circumference, different layer spacing and independent ridge curves; visual review confirms widening and narrowing on both sides.

crest_preservation.evidence: Five original crest curves sampled at16 azimuths against the constructed outer-skin faces in the committed cell. Original crest endpoint positions and neighboring exterior slope portions retained; no convex-edge fillet applied.
